name: public question examples before and after removing one edge
input: six vertices, one cycle, then remove edge 5 -> 2
test:
edges = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (2, 1), (1, 3), (5, 2), (5, 4)]
assert minimum_starting_vertices(6, edges) == 1
assert minimum_starting_vertices(6, [edge for edge in edges if edge != (5, 2)]) == 2
